observed: Core review of PR #20 found that ordinary ledger and export validation on a second machine rejected the copied run because the saved source-host Python executable path did not exist there.
expected: A reviewer can independently replay the saved evidence and evaluator inputs without that host path, while execution and resume still require exact runtime bytes.
root_cause: The only public validation path combined saved-artifact consistency checks with a local existence and byte check of the original executable.
fix: Added explicit read-only replay-artifacts commands for the ledger and export; strict validate, execute, resume, gate and checkpoint remain unchanged. The result identifies saved-artifacts-only scope and runtime-attestation not-rechecked.
regression_test: test_retrieval_execution.ExecutionTests.test_saved_artifact_replay_works_without_original_runtime and test_stage1_export.Stage1ExportTests.test_rehash_tamper_rejected_by_metric_recomputation; clean detached checkout replay of the PR ZIP.
rerun_result: The 227-test plugin suite passed with two platform skips. The clean-checkout report verifies 1,241 ZIP inventory files, both content replays, no changed extracted files and a shared source state hash; original-host runtime attestation remains separate.

observed: The first full plugin test run after changing the capability registry had 13 evaluation-plan, judge-bundle and paired-evaluation failures because the synthetic plan still named the previous registry hash.
expected: Synthetic contract fixtures remain bound to the current capability registry without changing any private holdout or formal evaluation plan.
root_cause: The public synthetic evaluation plan and its judge bundle form a hash chain over the versioned registry.
fix: Recomputed the registry canonical hash in the synthetic plan and the resulting synthetic plan hash in the synthetic judge bundle; no production rubric or private answer was changed.
regression_test: Evaluation-plan 11/11, judge-bundle 6/6 and paired-evaluation 7/7 targeted tests, followed by the full plugin suite.
rerun_result: All 24 targeted tests and all 227 full-suite tests passed; two symlink tests were skipped by Windows permissions.

observed: One initial full-suite runtime identity test failed closed after a CP437 Python bytecode cache file appeared in the inventoried interpreter tree during the test run.
expected: The frozen runtime tree stays byte-identical from capture to replay.
root_cause: Operator helper Python commands were run concurrently without no-bytecode mode while the full suite hashed the same interpreter tree.
fix: Stopped concurrent helper writes and used PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 plus -B for subsequent Python commands; did not weaken strict runtime validation.
regression_test: The merged-hub runtime replay file passed 3/3 alone, then the complete plugin suite reran without concurrent Python helper writes.
rerun_result: The complete suite passed 227 tests with two platform skips in 438.804 seconds.

observed: A first single-test command could not import test_retrieval_audit because it addressed test_retrieval_execution through a dotted path from the repository root.
expected: The new missing-runtime regression executes and reports its result.
root_cause: The test module imports a sibling test file, so its directory must be importable for a direct dotted test invocation.
fix: Ran that single test from the test directory with the module name test_retrieval_execution.
rerun_result: The single test passed, and the later full suite also passed it.

observed: Initial Ruff format and check commands failed because ruff was not on the operator shell PATH.
expected: The changed Python files pass the repository formatter and linter.
root_cause: The checkout's bundled Ruff executable is in scripts/.venv/Scripts rather than the shell PATH.
fix: Invoked that exact executable on the changed Python paths and formatted two files.
regression_test: Ruff format --check, Ruff check and git diff --check on the final change.

observed: One exploratory rg command named a nonexistent .github/scripts/schemas directory, and one apply_patch attempt targeted pre-format context that Ruff had changed.
expected: Inspect the real validator/fixture locations and apply the intended test assertion.
root_cause: An assumed schema path and stale formatting context were used in operator-only commands.
fix: Read the actual .github/scripts validator and plugin schema paths; inspected the formatted test lines and applied the corrected patch.
regression_test: Targeted searches found the readiness manifest validator and the corrected test passed in the full suite.
rerun_result: No product file changed from either failed command; the corrected test and all 227 plugin tests passed.
